text:
jordan: quick follow-up from last night's surge — storage-cleanup caused a paging spike, lots of duplicates. we need a tiny, actionable checklist with owners and deadlines.

maria: saw ~110 pages in 12m, ~80% duplicates. cause = retry storm + low alert threshold + no upstream dedupe.

kevin: propose 3 quick actions i can own #1
1) bump storage-cleanup alert threshold 4 -> 20 failures/10m. owner: kevin. due: 2025-01-15.
2) add grouping in Alertmanager (group_by job+alertname, group_interval 5m). owner: jordan. due: 2025-01-13.
3) ingestion dedupe window 2m (collapse identical fingerprints; include count). owner: maria. due: 2025-01-14.

sara: i'll add an auto-silence around the scheduled cleanup cron (0 03 * * * utc) +/-2m and PR ops-config. owner: sara. due: 2025-01-12.

nora: i'll update the runbook with an explicit "silence + verify" checklist and escalation contact. owner: nora. due: 2025-01-16.

jordan: ops-bot create ticket?

ops-bot: created SINF-380 - "paging surge: storage-cleanup" -> https://boards.redwood.internal/SINF-380

maria: decision: collapse duplicates but keep count in alert summary. also add a tiny retry backoff in the job to smooth bursts. i'll add that to the job PR.

kevin: i'll open the threshold PR and include a short test showing page reduction.

jordan: scheduling a 10m sync Wed 10am PST to review PRs and mark items in the postmortem follow-up. if anyone needs to reassign, reply here.

maria: i'll add a dashboard panel for duplicate-rate to monitor post-change.

jordan: thanks, closing this thread for action tracking.
